status_text_and_mapping.text_source: IWbemStatusCodeText::GetErrorCodeText(hr, 0, 0) from wmiutils.dll; the build carries a table of 180 measured WBEM and Win32 texts
translations_unavoidable: CIM status code of an MSFT_WmiError detail to a WMI HRESULT
SOAP subcode without a status (ActionNotSupported, DestinationUnreachable, CannotProcessFilter, InvalidSelectors, TimedOut, AccessDenied) to a WMI HRESULT
NTLM authentication failure and HTTP 401 to 0x80070005
TCP connect failure and connect timeout to 0x800706BA
other transport failure, malformed reply, and fault without a status to 0x80041001
pass_throughs: HRESULT quoted in the innermost WS-Management message
status text taken from the measured table for the resulting code
status_text_and_mapping.modeled_lookup: For a single node, a path or class target whose class is unknown reports 0x80041002 (Not found) instead of 0x80041010. This models the class lookup that classic performs before the query. A command with two or more nodes does not rewrite the code.
status_text_and_mapping.session_codes: Fail-fast uses the classic code 0xABE3 with the raw text; no HRESULT is rewritten.

fixes: A projection keeps __PROPERTY_COUNT as the number of non-system properties kept, with key properties the server added; __DYNASTY is empty; __DERIVATION and __SUPERCLASS are empty unless named
An unknown alias is named unless it equals the password value
An invalid namespace uses the connect operation: no Node line, no blank output
The method name in Executing follows the verb type of the alias verb: VerbType 0 uses the definition casing, no verb type uses the typed text; the method that runs stays the alias derivation
An unknown method on a path or class target reports Invalid class method. with status 0xABFC, also on Windows
Fail-fast prints Node - <node> and the raw text for GET, and the raw text alone for CALL; status 0xABE3
Standard output of GET and LIST is formatted once per command: the tables of the nodes that answered, or one pair of blank lines when every node failed
RAWXML and XML show a failed node as an ERROR result in the one command document
CALL, SET, CREATE and DELETE on a node list print a Node line on standard output before the output of each node
/RECORD with a node list writes one RECORD element with the node list as target and the standard output of the command as text
The namespace switch does not change an alias target

extra_reference.note: Cases E1 to E15 ran on the same reference host against the lab node, two addresses with no host, and the reference host itself. 39 runs: 24 are repeats, merged-stream forms or variants.
extra_reference.run_mode: pipe: WMIC.exe started directly with stdout and stderr on separate pipes; merge: cmd.exe /s /c with 2>&1; file: cmd.exe /s /c with > file; record: /record:<file> read after the run

placeholders.<unreachable-2>: a second address with no host

measured_after.working_tree: uncommitted changes on top of the base commit
measured_after.method: The release binary ran on the Mac. Reachable-node cases ran through lab-run.ps1 (SSH tunnel to the node WinRM listener on TCP 5985). Cases with unreachable nodes ran on the Mac with /user:x /password:y. Stdout and stderr were read as separate files. The Mac writes LF where classic writes the sequence in the classic columns.

not run again.19: password redaction by design; the document is covered by the E4 test
not run again.20: differs by design (the build reads the pipe)

original_cases.note: In the lab runs the password comes from the pipe, so case 5 prints the alias name, as case c05 of the measurement did.

measured_after.extra_cases: The verdict of each of E1 to E15 is in extra_cases[].after.verdict.
unmodeled: E11b: classic printed empty __PATH, __NAMESPACE and __SERVER for process where ProcessId=4, and a Handle=4 line. The cause is unknown. The build prints the three values and no Handle line.
E11a: classic printed no system property when __PROPERTY_COUNT is the only system property named beside a regular property. The build prints the ten system properties.
E1_pipe_r1: one of eight runs of the two-node fail-fast case took 37809 ms and gave the DCOM text for the second node. The build gives the fail-fast text for both nodes, as the other seven runs did.
The prompt casing of /INTERACTIVE:ON for a method is not measured.
__DERIVATION of CIM_System and CIM_Service is not measured.
A write verb (SET, CREATE, DELETE) on a node list was not measured. The build prints the Node line like CALL.
A connection error other than 0x800706BA and 0xABE3 for CALL was not measured. The build uses the CALL layout for every connection error.
